DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The presence of acetylcholine receptor antibodies combined with the specific EMG findings of decreased response to repetitive stimulation confirms this diagnosis. Your symptoms of activity-induced weakness and eye movement-related double vision are classic for this condition. I will now proceed with finalizing your treatment plan.
